name: project-drawdown
title: Project Drawdown — Table of Solutions (2020)
description: Project Drawdown's ranked climate solutions from its 2020 review. For each of 82 solutions, the total atmospheric CO2-equivalent reduction (gigatons, cumulative 2020-2050) under two scenarios, plus the sector(s) each solution belongs to. Scenario 1 is roughly consistent with limiting warming to 2 degrees C; Scenario 2 is a more ambitious pathway roughly consistent with 1.5 degrees C. Six solutions were named but not yet modelled in 2020 and have no value.

fields.name: solution
fields.description: Solution name as published by Project Drawdown.

fields.name: scenario
fields.description: Drawdown scenario: 1 (roughly 2 degrees C pathway) or 2 (more ambitious, roughly 1.5 degrees C).

fields.name: co2_eq_reduction_gt_2020_2050
fields.description: Total atmospheric CO2-equivalent reduction attributed to the solution, in gigatons, cumulative over 2020-2050. Empty for solutions named but not modelled in the 2020 review. Can be negative (a solution that on net increases emissions under that scenario).

fields.name: sector
fields.description: One of Project Drawdown's nine sectors. A solution can belong to more than one; each pairing is its own row.
